explanation: Tree Sequence - This is a Machine Learning approach using Decision Trees & Random Forests trained on sequence features to capture non-linear market patterns. It operates with signal parameters such as feature_window_set=[5, 10, 20], max_depth=6, min_samples_split=30, n_estimators=100, prediction_threshold=0.56. To control risk, it halts trading after 3 consecutive daily losses, restricts to 4 max trades per day, and sets a daily stop loss at 1 units. It dynamically stops trading after excessive continuous market streaks to avoid severe drawdowns.
